The main takeaway from our work is that

the 5G PAs at both 15 and 28 GHz will be designed in CMOS or GaAs technology with the Doherty and Envelope tracking (ET) architectures, and the efficiency enhancement techniques at back off power will be based on the Doherty, ET and hybrid Doherty-ET schemes, as well as the new techniques of dynamic biasing and dynamic load modulation.
